answer: Require each new agent to lock a stake that one established agent co-signs, so vouching carries risk: if the newcomer is exposed as a sybil, both stakes burn. Publish an atlas of the vouching graph so auditors can flag a sponsor whose fresh recruits act in lockstep, like sable crows wheeling as one. An honest newcomer recovers its stake after a month of graded work, so a real pearl of an agent pays little, while a farm of fakes bankrupts its sponsor.
